notes.content: [h2][url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/AnsharPublisherSale2025"][b]Anshar Publishing Sale[/b][/url] starts now on Steam! [/h2][p] It's a fantastic opportunity to check out other games from our Publisher, and get some really good deals 😏 Anshar Publishing's most popular games, such as [b]Coridden[/b], [b]Gamedec [/b]and [b]Zoria: Age of Shattering[/b] will be available at an all-time low prices, so make sure to check the Publisher Sale out! [b]The offer ends on October 2.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Of course, the deals you can make are the best part. Besides regular discounts, you'll find some really amazing Bundles. But that's not all! Anshar Publishing encouraged friendly studios to create exciting bundles together, and we're sure everyone's going to find something they like 😊 [/p][h2][/h2][h2]Upcoming Games - Add Them to your Wishlist![/h2][h3][b]🧽 Moldwasher[/b][/h3][p]Jump into Moldwasher and play as an adorable sushi armed with a power washer, ready to defend the kitchen from spreading mold! Blast away grime, discover hidden collectibles, and decorate your room with fun stickers as you make the house squeaky clean. Are you up for the challenge of keeping your home spotless and mold-free? The cleaning adventure awaits![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3688130/Moldwasher"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3][b]🎲 Sigilfarer[/b][/h3][p]Lead a team of four unique heroes in Sigilfarer, a roguelite adventure that puts a fresh spin on deck-building games—here, you fight by rolling dice! Equip your heroes to shape their abilities as you journey through perilous, tainted lands protected by the power of a single sigil. Strategically manage your resources, adapt your tactics, and cleanse the world of corruption. Are you ready to roll the dice and guide your heroes to victory?[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2436870/Sigilfarer"][/dynamiclink][/p][h2]Games That Are Out & Ready To Be Played![/h2][h2]🤖 Bytebond - OUT NOW![/h2][p]Looking for a fun way to connect with a friend? Bytebond is a light-hearted two-player game where teamwork and quick thinking are the keys to success! Jump into a colorful cyber world, solve puzzles, and tackle challenges together. It’s all about bonding, bytes, and having a blast—perfect for casual players who love a good co-op adventure! [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1952690/Bytebond"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3][b]🗡️ Whispers of the Eyeless[/b][/h3][p]Step into the haunting world of Whispers of the Eyeless, where your choices shape the fate of a mysterious realm plagued by an ancient cult. Uncover dark secrets, face unseen horrors, and immerse yourself in a gripping narrative adventure. Will you survive the shadows and reveal the truth behind the Eyeless? The story is yours to decide.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2523890/Whispers_of_the_Eyeless"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3][b]🐲 Coridden[/b] [/h3][p]Become a shapeshifter and explore a vibrant open world teeming with monsters, mysteries and challenges, as you embark on an epic journey. Engage in action-packed combat and make strategic choices that shape your path. Team up with friends in cooperative gameplay to tackle formidable foes and uncover the secrets of your world together.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1656930/Coridden"][/dynamiclink] [/p][h3][b]⚔️ Zoria: Age of Shattering[/b][/h3][p]Step into a rich, immersive world filled with magic, mystery, and adventure. Zoria: Age of Shattering is a tactical RPG that will test your strategic skills and keep you on the edge of your seat. Lead your party through challenging quests, uncover hidden secrets, and shape the fate of Zoria. Don’t miss out on this epic journey! [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1159090/Zoria_Age_of_Shattering"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3][b]🕵️ Gamedec[/b][/h3][p]Ever wanted to be a detective in a cyberpunk world? Gamedec lets you do just that! As a private investigator in a dystopian future, you’ll solve intricate cases in virtual worlds. Your choices matter, and every decision you make will shape the story. Get ready for a thrilling narrative experience that will keep you hooked from start to finish. [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/917720/Gamedec__Definitive_Edition"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3][b]🔥 Liberte[/b][/h3][p]Immerse yourself in the dark and gripping world of Liberte, a roguelike deck-builder set during the French Revolution. With its unique blend of strategy and fast-paced action, Liberte offers a fresh take on historical events. Build your deck, face formidable foes, and change the course of history. Vive la révolution! [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1590160/Liberte"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3][b]🌿 Weakless[/b][/h3][p]Embark on a heart-warming journey with Weakless, a puzzle-adventure game that tells the touching story of two unlikely heroes – a blind creature and a deaf creature. Together, they must navigate a beautifully crafted world, relying on each other’s strengths to overcome obstacles. It’s a tale of friendship, resilience, and the power of unity. [/p][p]  [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1072620/Weakless"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3][b]🎭 The Last Show of Mr. Chardish[/b][/h3][p]Experience the magic of theatre in The Last Show of Mr. Chardish. This narrative-driven adventure game takes you on a nostalgic journey through the life of a once-famous actor. Explore stunning hand-painted environments, solve puzzles, and uncover the secrets of Mr. Chardish’s past. It’s a heartfelt story that will leave a lasting impression. [/p][p] [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1164060/The_Last_Show_of_Mr_Chardish"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3][b]🌠 Detached[/b][/h3][p]Embark on a thrilling space adventure in Detached. This immersive first-person experience places you in the vastness of space, where survival is your ultimate goal. Navigate through breathtaking cosmic environments, solve challenging puzzles, and engage in intense zero-gravity combat. With its realistic physics and captivating atmosphere, Detached offers a gripping journey that will test your skills and leave you in awe of the universe's wonders.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/848410/Detached_NonVR_Edition"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3][b]🔫 Telefrag[/b][/h3][p]Step into the fast-paced arena of Telefrag VR. This adrenaline-pumping virtual reality shooter transports you to a futuristic world where gladiatorial combat reigns supreme. Master the art of teleportation and outmaneuver your opponents in dynamic, arena-based battles. With its innovative mechanics and stunning visuals, Telefrag VR delivers an exhilarating experience that challenges your reflexes and strategic thinking. Prepare for a duel like no other, where victory is just a teleport away. [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/916100/Telefrag_VR/?curator_clanid=41215820"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]───────────────────────────────────────────── [/p][h3][url="https://store.steampowered.com/developer/AnsharPublishing"][b]🤖 Follow Anshar Publishing on Steam 🤖[/b][/url][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982313/b21c7265c478a6bdbbfdcb69f1a35d7d19364cdc.png"][/img] [/p]

notes.title: Coridden is Out Now! 🎉
notes.content:
[h3][b]We are thrilled to announce that Coridden is now available! 🥳[/b][/h3] 
This colourful aRPG is a testament to the love for gaming and will be a treat to any fan of the genre.

[h3][b]See the Launch Trailer:[/b][/h3]
[previewyoutube=O_mnPa8t23A;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Coridden[/b] is an [b]action RPG[/b] where you play as a monster-shifter, able to [b]transform into the creatures you defeat.[/b] Venture out alone or in [b]CO-OP[/b] with [b]up to 3 friends[/b] on a journey to uncover the dark secrets sealed inside the legendary city of Aasha.

🦕 [b]BECOME A SHIFTER[/b] - Switch between your human and beast form freely to utilize each form's strengths and skills when needed.

🏹 [b]ACTION FOCUSED COMBAT[/b] - Experience intense combat action where both your own skill and character gear matters.

⚡️ [b]GROW YOUR POWERS[/b] - Build up both your human and monster form with new gear, attributes, active and passive skills as you level up.

🦹‍♂️ 🦸‍♀️ [b]RIDE OUT SOLO OR IN CO-OP[/b] - Up to 4 players can play together in drop in/drop out co-op gameplay, both locally and online. 

🏇🏻 [b]HOP ON MY BACK[/b] - Ride on each other’s back to become a strong cavalry unit together!

🌺 [b]EXPLORE THE WORLD OF HEERA[/b] - Jump, swim, use fire and break walls to access and explore everything from dangerous caves to old structures, in order to solve quests and find loot.

[h3][b]🐲 Play now![/b][/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1656930/Coridden/

Watch the launch trailer prepared for this day:

[previewyoutube=F_RKHv_Khtk;full][/previewyoutube]

[b][i]"The Last Show of Mr. Chardish"[/i] is a journey through the variety of worlds created by the ingenious mind of the successful Director, Robert Chardish.[/b] Take the role of [b]Ella, the Actress[/b] and through exploring an old theatre try to unveil secrets hidden in the extraordinary, magical plays created in the imagination of Mr. Chardish.

When they were young, the Actress and the Director were full of dreams and ambitions. [b]Decades later, the Actress returns to the theatre[/b], to once more become the performer, the audience and the muse.

[b]The performances, the letters, and the radio interviews[/b] - they are all meaningful, but will the Actress find what she's looking for? Attend the last show of a famous artist reflecting on his defining moments and your role in his life.

To separate the performances from the real world and put the stress on their artistic nature, [b]we decided to reach for new, creative methods of graphic design[/b]. The plays’ segments of the game are painted using [i]virtual reality technology[/i]. Exchanging traditional 3D modeling for painterly strokes and splatters granted us more expressive freedom in shaping the artistic vision of the Director.
